page.overview:
Who is Merise Haindehl?

She is tall, with blue eyes and dark hair drawn severely back and an ivory complexion. She is stern-faced with a stern manner. Some thought her beautiful without being pretty, some saw her as handsome, while others saw only severity.

Merise has a strength in the One Power of , making her very strong in the Aes Sedai hierarchy. Few are as strong as her, and fewer stronger. She is strong enough to be able to Travel.

She has an ability at Healing, although not as good as Corele Hovian.

She went to the White Tower in at the age of thirteen, an extremely young age for a Novice. She lied about her age but was discovered, and so she spent fifteen years as a novice and five as Accepted.
